title: Rude Elevation
prompt: dance pop euro pop, uk garage, fast and high energy
description: A percussion-led UK garage workout that kicks off with skippy 2-step drums and sawtooth chord stabs, builds through two surging peaks separated by a stripped-back valley, and lands you breathless by the outro. The TR909 kit swings hard — syncopated kick, shuffled hats, and ghost rim shots keep the groove bumpy throughout.
